summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Leads located for Nepal's bilateral investment treaties: the UNCTAD IIA Navigator Nepal page and India-Nepal BIT record, the Investment Laws Navigator and Investment Policy Monitor (incl. FITTA 2019), Nepal-official treaty downloads (InvestNepal portal, Department of Industry notice), US State Department Investment Climate Statements (2021, 2024) as a tier-4 cross-check, the India-Nepal BIPPA text, and UNCTAD's IPR implementation report. Located leads name a small set of partners (France, Germany, United Kingdom, Finland, Mauritius, India); signature, ratification and termination status are pending retrieval. The India-Nepal BIPPA status is contested across leads (entry into force vs reported Indian revocation) and must be settled from dated instruments. ISDS/ICSID information was not located.

findings.claim: Q1 Inventory of Nepal's BITs: partner, date of signature, ratification/entry into force, termination.
findings.note: IIA Navigator D01 (primary for status), cross-checked with Nepal-official InvestNepal/DoI D06/D07 and US ICS D08/D09. Keep conflicting status records side by side.

findings.claim: Q1 Status of the India-Nepal BIPPA (2011): in force, never in force, or terminated.
findings.note: Conflicting descriptions in located leads (Navigator D02, treaty text D10, Supreme Court news D11). Requires Navigator status record plus Indian and Nepali official notices on entry into force and any termination notice.

findings.claim: Q1 Treaties with investment provisions (FTAs/regional agreements with investment chapters) and double taxation agreements relevant to investors.
findings.note: D01 'TIPs' tab; DTAAs via D06. Not yet retrieved.

findings.claim: Dispute-resolution framework: ICSID/New York Convention membership, ISDS clauses in BITs, and known investor-state cases involving Nepal.
findings.note: UNCTAD ISDS Navigator and ICSID member list required; no lead located in r1 (search budget exhausted).

findings.claim: Treaty status hierarchy: UNCTAD IIA Navigator status is the default record; Nepal-official lists override only when they cite a dated instrument (ratification or termination notice); disagreements are recorded, not resolved silently.

data_gaps: Navigator status fields (signed/in force/terminated) for every Nepal IIA - not retrieved.
Dated ratification instruments and any termination notices, esp. India-Nepal BIPPA.
ICSID and New York Convention membership records; UNCTAD ISDS Navigator entries for Nepal - no lead.
Double taxation agreement list (Inland Revenue Department) - lead D06 only.
Sanctions-compliance and financial-standards obligations (FATF/APG) are covered by 16B/20-series leads; not duplicated here.

assumptions.text: Partner names in bit_inventory are candidates drawn from lead descriptions; status is not asserted until the Navigator and a Nepal-official record are retrieved.

challenges.text: Investment-protection assumptions in FDI scenarios should not presume treaty coverage for India (largest investor candidate) until the India-Nepal BIPPA status is resolved.
Add InvestNepal portal and ICSID/UNCTAD ISDS Navigator to the source catalog; leads D06, D08-D12 carry source_id null.

uncertainty: High. No treaty status retrieved. Partner list may be incomplete (treaties with investment provisions and recently signed BITs not checked). India-Nepal BIPPA status conflict is material for FDI scenarios.

fields_pending: in force (leads suggest not in force - verify)

bit_inventory.conflict: leads describe both an in-force treaty with automatic renewal and a revocation by India; resolve from dated instruments

bit_inventory.partner: Other IIAs / treaties with investment provisions
